cutoff_date_for_test = datetime(2023, 12, 20, tzinfo=pytz.UTC)

cutoff_date_for_train = datetime(2024, 1, 20, tzinfo=pytz.UTC)

directory = r'E:\01_calculate_talib\New folder (2)'

csv_files = [file for file in os.listdir(directory) if file.endswith('.csv')]


def splid_csv_data(file_path, file):
    # Read the CSV file
    print(f'processing {file}')
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

    # Convert the 'Date' column to datetime
    df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
    # Filter rows where 'Date' is after the filter_date
    df_filtered_to_train = df[df['Date'] < cutoff_date_for_train]
    df_filtered_last = df[df['Date'] >= cutoff_date_for_test]

    output_path_last_month = os.path.join(directory, f'last_month_{file}')
    output_path_train = os.path.join(directory, f'train_{file}')
    # Write the filtered data to a new CSV file
    df_filtered_last.to_csv(output_path_last_month, index=False)
    df_filtered_to_train.to_csv(output_path_train, index=False)
    print('separated')


with ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
    futures = []
    for file in csv_files:
        file_path = os.path.join(directory, file)
        splid_csv_data(file_path, file)
        futures.append(executor.submit(splid_csv_data, file_path, file))

    for future in as_completed(futures):
        pass

print("Filtered CSV files have been created.")

Based on the examples of similar text pairs chosen by their LCS (longest common string) from raw unlabeled documents, our pretraining scheme consists of masked language modeling combined with a unsupervised contrastive learning task. The resulting model GUR performs surprisingly well without any labeled training datapoints.  Public Class DenseTensor(Of T)
    Friend Sub New(ByVal fromArray As Array, Optional ByVal reverseStride As Boolean = False)
                        MyBase.New()

                        ' Copy initial array
                        Dim backingArray(fromArray.Length - 1) As T

                        Dim index As Integer = 0
                        If reverseStride Then
                            ' Array is always row-major
                            Dim sourceStrides() As Integer = ArrayUtilities.GetStrides(dimensions)

                            For Each item In fromArray
                                Dim destIndex As Integer = ArrayUtilities.TransformIndexByStrides(index, sourceStrides, False, strides)
                                backingArray(destIndex) = DirectCast(item, T)
                                index += 1
                            Next
                        Else
                            For Each item In fromArray
                                backingArray(index) = DirectCast(item, T)
                                index += 1
                            Next
                        End If

                        memory = backingArray
                    End Sub
End Class

Public Class ArrayUtilities
    Public Shared Function GetStrides(dimensions As ReadOnlySpan(Of Integer), Optional reverseStride As Boolean = False) As Integer()
                        Dim strides = New Integer(dimensions.Length - 1) {}

                        If dimensions.Length = 0 Then
                            Return strides
                        End If

                        Dim stride = 1
                        If reverseStride Then
                            For i = 0 To strides.Length - 1
                                strides(i) = stride
                                stride *= dimensions(i)
                            Next
                        Else
                            For i = strides.Length - 1 To 0 Step -1
                                strides(i) = stride
                                stride *= dimensions(i)
                            Next
                        End If

                        Return strides
                    End Function
End Class

 Public Class DenseTensor(Of T)
    Friend Sub New(ByVal fromArray As Array, Optional ByVal reverseStride As Boolean = False)
                        MyBase.New()

                        ' Copy initial array
                        Dim backingArray(fromArray.Length - 1) As T

                        Dim index As Integer = 0
                        If reverseStride Then
                            ' Array is always row-major
                            Dim sourceStrides() As Integer = ArrayUtilities.GetStrides(dimensions)

                            For Each item In fromArray
                                Dim destIndex As Integer = ArrayUtilities.TransformIndexByStrides(index, sourceStrides, False, strides)
                                backingArray(destIndex) = DirectCast(item, T)
                                index += 1
                            Next
                        Else
                            For Each item In fromArray
                                backingArray(index) = DirectCast(item, T)
                                index += 1
                            Next
                        End If

                        memory = backingArray
                    End Sub
End Class

Public Class ArrayUtilities
    Public Shared Function GetStrides(dimensions As ReadOnlySpan(Of Integer), Optional reverseStride As Boolean = False) As Integer()
                        Dim strides = New Integer(dimensions.Length - 1) {}

                        If dimensions.Length = 0 Then
                            Return strides
                        End If

                        Dim stride = 1
                        If reverseStride Then
                            For i = 0 To strides.Length - 1
                                strides(i) = stride
                                stride *= dimensions(i)
                            Next
                        Else
                            For i = strides.Length - 1 To 0 Step -1
                                strides(i) = stride
                                stride *= dimensions(i)
                            Next
                        End If

                        Return strides
                    End Function
End Class

        self.start_col_entry = tk.Entry(self)

        self.end_col_entry = tk.Entry(self)
        self.end_col_entry.pack(pady=5)

        select_button = tk.Button(self, text="선택", command=self.select_sheet_range)
        select_button.pack(pady=10)

    def select_sheet_range(self):
        selected_sheet_name = self.selected_sheet.get()
        start_row = int(self.start_row_spinbox.get())
        end_row = int(self.end_row_spinbox.get())
        start_col = str(self.start_col_entry.get())  # Convert to string
        end_col = str(self.end_col_entry.get())  # Convert to string

        if start_row <= end_row and start_col <= end_col:
            self.selection_info['sheet_name'] = selected_sheet_name
            self.selection_info['start_row'] = start_row
            self.selection_info['end_row'] = end_row
            self.selection_info['start_col'] = start_col
            self.selection_info['end_col'] = end_col
            self.destroy()

        Returns:

        cost = 0

        distance = sum(abs(control.delta_s) for control in controls)

        cusp = 0
        kappa_diff = 0

        kappa_discontinuity = 0

        flatness = 0

        for contol in range(len(controls) - 1):
            if controls[contol].delta_s * controls[contol + 1].delta_s < 0:
                cusp += 1

            if controls[contol].kappa * controls[contol + 1].kappa < 0:

            kappa_diff += abs(controls[contol].kappa - controls[contol + 1].kappa)

            flatness += abs(controls[contol].kappa) * abs(controls[contol].delta_s)
